sources.title: Piracy monthly report May 2025
sources.text: Four robbers armed with a knife boarded the tanker underway and entered the engine room. The alarm was raised, a PA announcement was made, all deck lights were switched on, VTIS informed, distress messages were broadcasted, and the crew was mustered. Upon hearing the alarm, the robbers fled with stolen engine spares. After anchoring, the police coast guard boarded the tanker for inspection.
